PR07: resolve reviewer feedback on canvas chrome theming

- apply ruler major/minor tick lengths in the painter (theme mode)
- thread guide dashPattern into the boundary guide painter; null stays solid
- paint frame cornerRadius/backgroundColor via RRect fill + stroke
- split element theming into a background underlay before committed content
  and a foreground overlay after it
- keep the delete handle icon white under an aggregate handle theme
- honor strokeWidth for the resize handle
- carry the host PlateThemeData extension through PlateHostThemeScope so the
  public Plate entry point reaches the managed editor
- use an unset sentinel in copyWith so nullable theme fields can be cleared
- remove PlateGridThemeData (no visual consumer) from theme, barrel, docs
- pass the minimap theme through PlateCanvasOverlayContext to the default
  status overlay contribution
- export PlateTransformHandlePresentation, PlateSelectionConstraintContext,
  and TransformHandle through the support barrel
- add rendered-behavior and compile-only consumer tests for every thread
